text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Will the United States lift the travel ban soon?
-An Israeli air raid on the outskirts of the village of Sojoud in south Lebanon and a Hizbollah attack on an Israeli patrol inside the occupation zone.
-Israel's defence minister Mordechai: Peace is also a Syrian and Lebanese need.
The minister visited the commander of Israel's South Lebanon Army to show support after Lebanon passed a death sentence in absentia on him for collaborating with the Jewish state.
-Prosecution demanded the death penalty for four men for involvement in the killing of Suleiman, a finance ministry employee tied to a multi-million dollar fraud case.
-A European Union delegate stressed Europe's willingness to support Lebanon and its people.

-Several policemen were wounded in scuffles between student supporters of Hizbollah and Amal, two rival Shi'ite Moslem groups, over naming a prayer area at the state-run Lebanese University in Beirut.
-A support committee for captives in Israeli jails urged the Lebanese government to file a complaint against Israel at the International Court of Justice.
